description: One 15-minute sample of the CI (GitHub Actions) queue: depth, service, and wait. Emitted by telemetry/ci-queue/run-sample.mjs (FIX-22c). Records are append-only JSONL; see telemetry/ci-queue/README.md for cadence and the rho>1 knee alert. This schema is deliberately NOT the guild telemetry-bus finding schema: a gauge series is not a discrete falsifiable claim, and one finding per sample would break the bus's id-dedupe semantics.

knee.description: rho>1 knee detector verdict for the window ending at this sample.

rho_hat.description: Estimated utilization (queue-weighted) when estimable, else null.

max_wait_s.description: Longest current wait among queued runs, seconds. Null when none queued.

p50_wait_s.description: Median seconds queued runs have waited (now - created_at). Null when no runs are queued.

queued.description: Runs waiting for a runner (queued depth).

title: ci.queue_depth_sample
